For the current source, determine whether the focus unit itself supports, refutes, or leaves unknown the candidate operative_disposal: The units impose an operative return and/or destruction duty with its source-stated actor, information, trigger, choice allocation, and exceptions; they do not themselves grant post-disposal retention.. Use surrounding units only to resolve antecedents, alternatives, exceptions, or an identified governing process. Do not attribute a contextual unit's separate legal effect to the focus. Refute only when the focus's source-stated function conflicts with the candidate or the candidate adds an operative function the focus does not express; missing context or another compatible label is unknown. Rejection of this candidate does not establish any other choice.
